properties.clip_tabs: If [code]true[/code], tabs overflowing this node's width will be hidden, displaying two navigation buttons instead. Otherwise, this node's minimum size is updated so that all tabs are visible.
properties.tabs_visible: If [code]true[/code], tabs are visible. If [code]false[/code], tabs' content and titles are hidden.
properties.all_tabs_in_front: If [code]true[/code], all tabs are drawn in front of the panel. If [code]false[/code], inactive tabs are drawn behind the panel.
properties.switch_on_drag_hover: If [code]true[/code], hovering over a tab while dragging something will switch to that tab. Does not have effect when hovering another tab to rearrange.
properties.drag_to_rearrange_enabled: If [code]true[/code], tabs can be rearranged with mouse drag.
properties.tabs_rearrange_group:
[TabContainer]s with the same rearrange group ID will allow dragging the tabs between them. Enable drag with [member drag_to_rearrange_enabled].
Setting this to [code]-1[/code] will disable rearranging between [TabContainer]s.
properties.use_hidden_tabs_for_min_size: If [code]true[/code], child [Control] nodes that are hidden have their minimum size take into account in the total, instead of only the currently visible one.
properties.tab_focus_mode: The focus access mode for the internal [TabBar] node.
properties.deselect_enabled:
If [code]true[/code], all tabs can be deselected so that no tab is selected. Click on the [member current_tab] to deselect it.
Only the tab header will be shown if no tabs are selected.

signals.active_tab_rearranged: Emitted when the active tab is rearranged via mouse drag. See [member drag_to_rearrange_enabled].
signals.tab_changed: Emitted when switching to another tab.
signals.tab_clicked: Emitted when a tab is clicked, even if it is the current tab.
signals.tab_hovered: Emitted when a tab is hovered by the mouse.
signals.tab_selected: Emitted when a tab is selected via click, directional input, or script, even if it is the current tab.
signals.tab_button_pressed: Emitted when the user clicks on the button icon on this tab.
signals.pre_popup_pressed: Emitted when the [TabContainer]'s [Popup] button is clicked. See [method set_popup] for details.

TextEdit.description:
A multiline text editor. It also has limited facilities for editing code, such as syntax highlighting support. For more advanced facilities for editing code, see [CodeEdit].
While entering text, it is possible to insert special characters using Unicode, OEM or Windows alt codes:
- To enter Unicode codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the codepoint on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (U+00E1), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [kbd]+E1[/kbd] on the numpad (the leading zeroes can be omitted).
- To enter OEM codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (OEM 160), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [code]160[/code] on the numpad.
- To enter Windows codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (Windows 0225), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [kbd]0[/kbd], [kbd]2[/kbd], [kbd]2[/kbd], [kbd]5[/kbd] on the numpad. The leading zero here must [b]not[/b] be omitted, as this is how Windows codepoints are distinguished from OEM codepoints.
[b]Note:[/b] Most viewport, caret, and edit methods contain a [code]caret_index[/code] argument for [member caret_multiple] support. The argument should be one of the following: [code]-1[/code] for all carets, [code]0[/code] for the main caret, or greater than [code]0[/code] for secondary carets in the order they were created.
[b]Note:[/b] When holding down [kbd]Alt[/kbd], the vertical scroll wheel will scroll 5 times as fast as it would normally do. This also works in the Godot script editor.

methods._handle_unicode_input: Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the provided key [param unicode_char].
methods._backspace: Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the backspace key.
methods._cut: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.
methods._copy: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.
methods._paste: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation.
methods._paste_primary_clipboard:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation with middle mouse button.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is only implemented on Linux.
methods.has_ime_text: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user has text in the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME).
methods.cancel_ime: Closes the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME will be lost.
methods.apply_ime: Applies text from the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME) to each caret and closes the IME if it is open.
methods.set_tab_size: Sets the tab size for the [TextEdit] to use.
methods.set_overtype_mode_enabled: If [code]true[/code], enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing text instead of inserting text. The [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode] action toggles overtype mode. See [method is_overtype_mode_enabled].
methods.is_overtype_mode_enabled: Returns [code]true[/code] if overtype mode is enabled. See [method set_overtype_mode_enabled].
methods.clear: Performs a full reset of [TextEdit], including undo history.
methods.get_line_count: Returns the number of lines in the text.
methods.set_line:
Sets the text for a specific [param line].
Carets on the line will attempt to keep their visual x position.
methods.get_line: Returns the text of a specific line.
methods.get_line_with_ime: Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME composition string.
methods.get_line_width: Returns the width in pixels of the [param wrap_index] on [param line].
methods.get_line_height:
Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines.
[b]Note:[/b] The return value is influenced by [theme_item line_spacing] and [theme_item font_size]. And it will not be less than [code]1[/code].
methods.get_indent_level: Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size into account (see [method get_tab_size]).
methods.get_first_non_whitespace_column: Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of characters.
methods.swap_lines: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.
methods.insert_line_at: Inserts a new line with [param text] at [param line].
methods.remove_line_at:
Removes the line of text at [param line]. Carets on this line will attempt to match their previous visual x position.
If [param move_carets_down] is [code]true[/code] carets will move to the next line down, otherwise carets will move up.
methods.insert_text_at_caret: Insert the specified text at the caret position.
methods.insert_text:
Inserts the [param text] at [param line] and [param column].
If [param before_selection_begin] is [code]true[/code], carets and selections that begin at [param line] and [param column] will moved to the end of the inserted text, along with all carets after it.
If [param before_selection_end] is [code]true[/code], selections that end at [param line] and [param column] will be extended to the end of the inserted text. These parameters can be used to insert text inside of or outside of selections.
methods.remove_text: Removes text between the given positions.
methods.get_last_unhidden_line: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire [TextEdit].
methods.get_next_visible_line_offset_from: Returns the count to the next visible line from [param line] to [code]line + visible_amount[/code]. Can also count backwards. For example if a [TextEdit] has 5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with [code]line = 1, visible_amount = 1[/code] would return 3.
methods.get_next_visible_line_index_offset_from: Similar to [method get_next_visible_line_offset_from], but takes into account the line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, [code]x[/code] is the line, [code]y[/code] is the wrap index.
methods.backspace: Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with [method _backspace].
methods.cut: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with [method _cut].
methods.copy: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with [method _copy].
methods.paste: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with [method _paste].
methods.start_action:
Starts an action, will end the current action if [param action] is different.
An action will also end after a call to [method end_action], after [member ProjectSettings.gui/timers/text_edit_idle_detect_sec] is triggered or a new undoable step outside the [method start_action] and [method end_action] calls.
methods.end_action: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with [method start_action].
methods.begin_complex_operation: Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until [method end_complex_operation] is called.
methods.end_complex_operation: Ends a multipart edit, started with [method begin_complex_operation]. If called outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the undo/redo stack.
methods.has_undo: Returns [code]true[/code] if an "undo" action is available.
methods.has_redo: Returns [code]true[/code] if a "redo" action is available.
methods.tag_saved_version: Tag the current version as saved.
methods.get_version: Returns the current version of the [TextEdit]. The version is a count of recorded operations by the undo/redo history.
methods.get_saved_version: Returns the last tagged saved version from [method tag_saved_version].
methods.set_search_text: Sets the search text. See [method set_search_flags].
methods.set_search_flags: Sets the search [param flags]. This is used with [method set_search_text] to highlight occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the [enum SearchFlags] enum.
methods.set_tooltip_request_func: Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following args: [code]hovered_word: String[/code].
methods.get_local_mouse_pos: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.
methods.get_line_column_at_pos:
Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned vector, [code]x[/code] is the column and [code]y[/code] is the line.
If [param clamp_line] is [code]false[/code] and [param position] is below the last line, [code]Vector2i(-1, -1)[/code] is returned.
If [param clamp_column] is [code]false[/code] and [param position] is outside the column range of the line, [code]Vector2i(-1, -1)[/code] is returned.
methods.get_pos_at_line_column:
Returns the local position for the given [param line] and [param column]. If [code]x[/code] or [code]y[/code] of the returned vector equal [code]-1[/code], the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
[b]Note:[/b] The Y position corresponds to the bottom side of the line. Use [method get_rect_at_line_column] to get the top side position.
methods.get_rect_at_line_column:
Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given [param line] and [param column]. If [code]x[/code] or [code]y[/code] position of the returned rect equal [code]-1[/code], the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
[b]Note:[/b] The Y position of the returned rect corresponds to the top side of the line, unlike [method get_pos_at_line_column] which returns the bottom side.
methods.get_minimap_line_at_pos: Returns the equivalent minimap line at [param position].
methods.is_dragging_cursor: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling, selecting, or text dragging.
methods.is_mouse_over_selection: Returns [code]true[/code] if the mouse is over a selection. If [param edges] is [code]true[/code], the edges are considered part of the selection.
methods.add_caret: Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new caret, or [code]-1[/code] if the location is invalid.
methods.remove_caret:
Removes the given caret index.
[b]Note:[/b] This can result in adjustment of all other caret indices.
methods.get_caret_count: Returns the number of carets in this [TextEdit].
methods.add_caret_at_carets: Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If [param below] is [code]true[/code] the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.
methods.get_sorted_carets:
Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and column to highest (from top to bottom of text).
If [param include_ignored_carets] is [code]false[/code], carets from [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret] will be ignored.
methods.collapse_carets:
Collapse all carets in the given range to the [param from_line] and [param from_column] position.
[param inclusive] applies to both ends.
If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is [code]true[/code], carets that are collapsed will be [code]true[/code] for [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret].
[method merge_overlapping_carets] will be called if any carets were collapsed.
methods.merge_overlapping_carets:
Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret with a selection.
If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is [code]true[/code], the merge will be queued to happen at the end of the multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit].
[b]Note:[/b] This is not called when a caret changes position but after certain actions, so it is possible to get into a state where carets overlap.
methods.begin_multicaret_edit:
Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with [method end_multicaret_edit]. Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret indexes aren't affected immediately. [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit] can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last [method end_multicaret_edit].
[codeblock]
begin_complex_operation()
begin_multicaret_edit()
for i in range(get_caret_count()):
	if multicaret_edit_ignore_caret(i):
		continue
	# Logic here.
end_multicaret_edit()
end_complex_operation()
[/codeblock]
methods.end_multicaret_edit: Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with [method begin_multicaret_edit]. If this was the last [method end_multicaret_edit] and [method merge_overlapping_carets] was called, carets will be merged.
methods.is_in_mulitcaret_edit: Returns [code]true[/code] if a [method begin_multicaret_edit] has been called and [method end_multicaret_edit] has not yet been called.
methods.multicaret_edit_ignore_caret:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param caret_index] should be ignored as part of a multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit]. Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were added during the edit.
It is recommended to [code]continue[/code] within a loop iterating on multiple carets if a caret should be ignored.
methods.is_caret_visible:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the caret is visible, [code]false[/code] otherwise. A caret will be considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is enabled.
[b]Note:[/b] [method is_caret_visible] does not account for a caret being off-screen if it is still within the scrollable area. It will return [code]true[/code] even if the caret is off-screen as long as it meets [TextEdit]'s own conditions for being visible. This includes uses of [member scroll_fit_content_width] and [member scroll_fit_content_height] that cause the [TextEdit] to expand beyond the viewport's bounds.
methods.get_caret_draw_pos: Returns the caret pixel draw position.
methods.set_caret_line:
Moves the caret to the specified [param line] index. The caret column will be moved to the same visual position it was at the last time [method set_caret_column] was called, or clamped to the end of the line.
If [param adjust_viewport] is [code]true[/code], the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
If [param can_be_hidden] is [code]true[/code], the specified [param line] can be hidden.
If [param wrap_index] is [code]-1[/code], the caret column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than [code]-1[/code], the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_caret_column] was called.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].
methods.get_caret_line: Returns the line the editing caret is on.
methods.set_caret_column:
Moves the caret to the specified [param column] index.
If [param adjust_viewport] is [code]true[/code], the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].
methods.get_caret_column: Returns the column the editing caret is at.
methods.get_next_composite_character_column:
Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: [code]U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79[/code]) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
[b]Note:[/b] To check at caret location use [code]get_next_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())[/code]
methods.get_previous_composite_character_column:
Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: [code]U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79[/code]) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
[b]Note:[/b] To check at caret location use [code]get_previous_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())[/code]
methods.get_caret_wrap_index: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.
methods.get_word_under_caret: Returns a [String] text with the word under the caret's location.
methods.select_all:
Select all the text.
If [member selecting_enabled] is [code]false[/code], no selection will occur.
methods.select_word_under_caret: Selects the word under the caret.
methods.add_selection_for_next_occurrence: Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.
methods.skip_selection_for_next_occurrence: Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence of the word under caret.
methods.select:
Selects text from [param origin_line] and [param origin_column] to [param caret_line] and [param caret_column] for the given [param caret_index]. This moves the selection origin and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be deselected.
If [member selecting_enabled] is [code]false[/code], no selection will occur.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].
methods.has_selection: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user has selected text.
methods.get_selected_text: Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if [param caret_index] is its default value [code]-1[/code].
methods.get_selection_at_line_column:
Returns the caret index of the selection at the given [param line] and [param column], or [code]-1[/code] if there is none.
If [param include_edges] is [code]false[/code], the position must be inside the selection and not at either end. If [param only_selections] is [code]false[/code], carets without a selection will also be considered.
methods.get_line_ranges_from_carets:
Returns an [Array] of line ranges where [code]x[/code] is the first line and [code]y[/code] is the last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even if it has multiple carets on it.
If a selection's end column ([method get_selection_to_column]) is at column [code]0[/code], that line will not be included. If a selection begins on the line after another selection ends and [param merge_adjacent] is [code]true[/code], or they begin and end on the same line, one line range will include both selections.
methods.get_selection_origin_line: Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.
methods.get_selection_origin_column: Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.
methods.set_selection_origin_line:
Sets the selection origin line to the [param line] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
If [param can_be_hidden] is [code]false[/code], The line will be set to the nearest unhidden line below or above.
If [param wrap_index] is [code]-1[/code], the selection origin column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than [code]-1[/code], the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_selection_origin_column] or [method select] was called.
methods.set_selection_origin_column: Sets the selection origin column to the [param column] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
methods.get_selection_from_line: Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.
methods.get_selection_from_column: Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.
methods.get_selection_to_line: Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.
methods.get_selection_to_column: Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.
methods.is_caret_after_selection_origin: Returns [code]true[/code] if the caret of the selection is after the selection origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.
methods.is_line_wrapped: Returns if the given line is wrapped.
methods.get_line_wrap_count: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.
methods.get_line_wrap_index_at_column: Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This ranges from [code]0[/code] to [method get_line_wrap_count].
methods.get_line_wrapped_text: Returns an array of [String]s representing each wrapped index.
methods.get_scroll_pos_for_line: Returns the scroll position for [param wrap_index] of [param line].
methods.set_line_as_first_visible: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the top of the viewport.
methods.set_line_as_center_visible: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the center of the viewport.
methods.set_line_as_last_visible: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the bottom of the viewport.
methods.get_last_full_visible_line: Returns the last visible line. Use [method get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index] for the wrap index.
methods.get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index: Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.
methods.get_visible_line_count: Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based on this control's height.
methods.get_visible_line_count_in_range: Returns the total number of lines between [param from_line] and [param to_line] (inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to [method get_total_visible_line_count].
methods.get_total_visible_line_count: Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If [member wrap_mode] is set to [constant LINE_WRAPPING_NONE] and no lines are folded (see [method CodeEdit.is_line_folded]) then this is equivalent to [method get_line_count]. See [method get_visible_line_count_in_range] for a limited range of lines.
methods.adjust_viewport_to_caret: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.
methods.center_viewport_to_caret: Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also resets the [member scroll_horizontal] value to [code]0[/code].
methods.get_minimap_visible_lines: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.
methods.add_gutter: Register a new gutter to this [TextEdit]. Use [param at] to have a specific gutter order. A value of [code]-1[/code] appends the gutter to the right.
methods.remove_gutter: Removes the gutter at the given index.
methods.get_gutter_count: Returns the number of gutters registered.
methods.set_gutter_name: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.
methods.get_gutter_name: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.
methods.set_gutter_type: Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.
methods.get_gutter_type: Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.
methods.set_gutter_width: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.
methods.get_gutter_width: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.
methods.set_gutter_draw: If [code]true[/code], the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type ([method set_gutter_type]) determines how it is drawn. See [method is_gutter_drawn].
methods.is_gutter_drawn: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See [method set_gutter_draw].
methods.set_gutter_clickable: If [code]true[/code], the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand ([constant Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND]) when hovering over the gutter at the given index. See [method is_gutter_clickable] and [method set_line_gutter_clickable].
methods.is_gutter_clickable: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See [method set_gutter_clickable].
methods.set_gutter_overwritable: If [code]true[/code], the line data of the gutter at the given index can be overridden when using [method merge_gutters]. See [method is_gutter_overwritable].
methods.is_gutter_overwritable: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].
methods.merge_gutters: Merge the gutters from [param from_line] into [param to_line]. Only overwritable gutters will be copied. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].
methods.set_gutter_custom_draw: Set a custom draw callback for the gutter at the given index. [param draw_callback] must take the following arguments: A line index [int], a gutter index [int], and an area [Rect2]. This callback only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM] (see [method set_gutter_type]).
methods.get_total_gutter_width: Returns the total width of all gutters and internal padding.
methods.set_line_gutter_metadata: Sets the metadata for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param metadata].
methods.get_line_gutter_metadata: Returns the metadata currently in [param gutter] at [param line].
methods.set_line_gutter_text: Sets the text for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param text]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_STRING] (see [method set_gutter_type]).
methods.get_line_gutter_text: Returns the text currently in [param gutter] at [param line]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_STRING] (see [method set_gutter_type]).
methods.set_line_gutter_icon: Sets the icon for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param icon]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_ICON] (see [method set_gutter_type]).
methods.get_line_gutter_icon: Returns the icon currently in [param gutter] at [param line]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_ICON] (see [method set_gutter_type]).
methods.set_line_gutter_item_color: Sets the color for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param color].
methods.get_line_gutter_item_color: Returns the color currently in [param gutter] at [param line].
methods.set_line_gutter_clickable: If [param clickable] is [code]true[/code], makes the [param gutter] on the given [param line] clickable. This is like [method set_gutter_clickable], but for a single line. If [method is_gutter_clickable] is [code]true[/code], this will not have any effect. See [method is_line_gutter_clickable] and [signal gutter_clicked].
methods.is_line_gutter_clickable: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index on the given line is clickable. See [method set_line_gutter_clickable].
methods.set_line_background_color: Sets the custom background color of the given line. If transparent, this color is applied on top of the default background color (See [theme_item background_color]). If set to [code]Color(0, 0, 0, 0)[/code], no additional color is applied.
methods.get_line_background_color: Returns the custom background color of the given line. If no color is set, returns [code]Color(0, 0, 0, 0)[/code].
methods.is_menu_visible: Returns [code]true[/code] if the menu is visible. Use this instead of [code]get_menu().visible[/code] to improve performance (so the creation of the menu is avoided). See [method get_menu].
methods.menu_option: Executes a given action as defined in the [enum MenuItems] enum.
methods.get_caret_index_edit_order: Returns a list of caret indexes in their edit order, this done from bottom to top. Edit order refers to the way actions such as [method insert_text_at_caret] are applied.
methods.get_selection_line: Returns the original start line of the selection.
methods.get_selection_column: Returns the original start column of the selection.

properties.placeholder_text: Text shown when the [TextEdit] is empty. It is [b]not[/b] the [TextEdit]'s default value (see [member text]).
properties.editable: If [code]false[/code], existing text cannot be modified and new text cannot be added.
properties.context_menu_enabled: If [code]true[/code], a right-click displays the context menu.
properties.emoji_menu_enabled: If [code]true[/code], "Emoji and Symbols" menu is enabled.
properties.backspace_deletes_composite_character_en: If [code]true[/code] and [member caret_mid_grapheme] is [code]false[/code], backspace deletes an entire composite character such as ❤️‍🩹, instead of deleting part of the composite character.
properties.shortcut_keys_enabled: If [code]true[/code], shortcut keys for context menu items are enabled, even if the context menu is disabled.
properties.selecting_enabled:
If [code]true[/code], text can be selected.
If [code]false[/code], text can not be selected by the user or by the [method select] or [method select_all] methods.
properties.deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled: If [code]true[/code], the selected text will be deselected when focus is lost.
properties.drag_and_drop_selection_enabled: If [code]true[/code], allow drag and drop of selected text. Text can still be dropped from other sources.
properties.middle_mouse_paste_enabled:
If [code]false[/code], using middle mouse button to paste clipboard will be disabled.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is only implemented on Linux.
properties.empty_selection_clipboard_enabled: If [code]true[/code], copying or cutting without a selection is performed on all lines with a caret. Otherwise, copy and cut require a selection.
properties.wrap_mode: Sets the line wrapping mode to use.
properties.autowrap_mode: If [member wrap_mode] is set to [constant LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY], sets text wrapping mode.
properties.indent_wrapped_lines: If [code]true[/code], all wrapped lines are indented to the same amount as the unwrapped line.
properties.tab_input_mode: If [code]true[/code], [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_indent] input [code]Tab[/code] character, otherwise it moves keyboard focus to the next [Control] in the scene.
properties.virtual_keyboard_enabled: If [code]true[/code], the native virtual keyboard is enabled on platforms that support it.
properties.virtual_keyboard_show_on_focus: If [code]true[/code], the native virtual keyboard is shown on focus events on platforms that support it.
properties.scroll_smooth: Scroll smoothly over the text rather than jumping to the next location.
properties.scroll_v_scroll_speed: Sets the scroll speed with the minimap or when [member scroll_smooth] is enabled.
properties.scroll_past_end_of_file: Allow scrolling past the last line into "virtual" space.
properties.scroll_vertical: If there is a vertical scrollbar, this determines the current vertical scroll value in line numbers, starting at 0 for the top line.
properties.scroll_horizontal: If there is a horizontal scrollbar, this determines the current horizontal scroll value in pixels.
properties.scroll_fit_content_height: If [code]true[/code], [TextEdit] will disable vertical scroll and fit minimum height to the number of visible lines. When both this property and [member scroll_fit_content_width] are [code]true[/code], no scrollbars will be displayed.
properties.scroll_fit_content_width: If [code]true[/code], [TextEdit] will disable horizontal scroll and fit minimum width to the widest line in the text. When both this property and [member scroll_fit_content_height] are [code]true[/code], no scrollbars will be displayed.
properties.minimap_draw: If [code]true[/code], a minimap is shown, providing an outline of your source code. The minimap uses a fixed-width text size.
properties.minimap_width: The width, in pixels, of the minimap.
properties.caret_type: Set the type of caret to draw.
properties.caret_blink_interval: The interval at which the caret blinks (in seconds).
properties.caret_draw_when_editable_disabled: If [code]true[/code], caret will be visible when [member editable] is disabled.
properties.caret_move_on_right_click:
If [code]true[/code], a right-click moves the caret at the mouse position before displaying the context menu.
If [code]false[/code], the context menu ignores mouse location.
properties.caret_mid_grapheme:
Allow moving caret, selecting and removing the individual composite character components.
[b]Note:[/b] [kbd]Backspace[/kbd] is always removing individual composite character components.
properties.caret_multiple: If [code]true[/code], multiple carets are allowed. Left-clicking with [kbd]Alt[/kbd] adds a new caret. See [method add_caret] and [method get_caret_count].
properties.use_default_word_separators: If [code]false[/code], using [kbd]Ctrl + Left[/kbd] or [kbd]Ctrl + Right[/kbd] ([kbd]Cmd + Left[/kbd] or [kbd]Cmd + Right[/kbd] on macOS) bindings will stop moving caret only if a space or punctuation is detected. If [code]true[/code], it will also stop the caret if a character is part of [code]!"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^`{|}~[/code], the Unicode General Punctuation table, or the Unicode CJK Punctuation table. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the behavior of text selection.
properties.use_custom_word_separators: If [code]false[/code], using [kbd]Ctrl + Left[/kbd] or [kbd]Ctrl + Right[/kbd] ([kbd]Cmd + Left[/kbd] or [kbd]Cmd + Right[/kbd] on macOS) bindings will use the behavior of [member use_default_word_separators]. If [code]true[/code], it will also stop the caret if a character within [member custom_word_separators] is detected. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the behavior of text selection.
properties.custom_word_separators: The characters to consider as word delimiters if [member use_custom_word_separators] is [code]true[/code]. The characters should be defined without separation, for example [code]#_![/code].
properties.syntax_highlighter:
The syntax highlighter to use.
[b]Note:[/b] A [SyntaxHighlighter] instance should not be used across multiple [TextEdit] nodes.
properties.highlight_all_occurrences: If [code]true[/code], all occurrences of the selected text will be highlighted.
properties.highlight_current_line: If [code]true[/code], the line containing the cursor is highlighted.
properties.draw_tabs: If [code]true[/code], the "tab" character will have a visible representation.
properties.draw_spaces: If [code]true[/code], the "space" character will have a visible representation.
properties.language: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.
properties.structured_text_bidi_override: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.
properties.structured_text_bidi_override_options: Set additional options for BiDi override.

signals.text_set: Emitted when [method clear] is called or [member text] is set.
signals.lines_edited_from:
Emitted immediately when the text changes.
When text is added [param from_line] will be less than [param to_line]. On a remove [param to_line] will be less than [param from_line].
signals.caret_changed: Emitted when any caret changes position.
signals.gutter_clicked: Emitted when a gutter is clicked.
signals.gutter_added: Emitted when a gutter is added.
signals.gutter_removed: Emitted when a gutter is removed.

TextLine.description: Abstraction over [TextServer] for handling a single line of text.

methods.clear: Clears text line (removes text and inline objects).
methods.get_inferred_direction: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
methods.set_bidi_override:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.
methods.add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
methods.add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.
methods.resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
methods.has_object: Returns [code]true[/code] if an object with [param key] is embedded in this line.
methods.tab_align: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.
methods.get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
methods.get_size: Returns size of the bounding box of the text.
methods.get_line_ascent: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
methods.get_line_descent: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
methods.get_line_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.
methods.get_line_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods.draw: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_outline: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.hit_test: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

properties.preserve_invalid: If set to [code]true[/code] text will display invalid characters.
properties.preserve_control: If set to [code]true[/code] text will display control characters.
properties.alignment: Sets text alignment within the line as if the line was horizontal.
properties.flags: Line alignment rules. For more info see [TextServer].
properties.text_overrun_behavior: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the text line's set width.
properties.ellipsis_char: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.

TextMesh.description:
Generate a [PrimitiveMesh] from the text.
TextMesh can be generated only when using dynamic fonts with vector glyph contours. Bitmap fonts (including bitmap data in the TrueType/OpenType containers, like color emoji fonts) are not supported.
The UV layout is arranged in 4 horizontal strips, top to bottom: 40% of the height for the front face, 40% for the back face, 10% for the outer edges and 10% for the inner edges.

properties.text:
The text to generate mesh from.
[b]Note:[/b] Due to being a [Resource], it doesn't follow the rules of [member Node.auto_translate_mode]. If disabling translation is desired, it should be done manually with [method Object.set_message_translation].
properties.font: Font configuration used to display text.
properties.font_size:
Font size of the [TextMesh]'s text. This property works in tandem with [member pixel_size]. Higher values will result in a more detailed font, regardless of [member curve_step] and [member pixel_size]. Consider keeping this value below 63 (inclusive) for good performance, and adjust [member pixel_size] as needed to enlarge text.
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.scale] instead.
properties.horizontal_alignment: Controls the text's horizontal alignment. Supports left, center, right, and fill (also known as justify).
properties.vertical_alignment: Controls the text's vertical alignment. Supports top, center, and bottom.
properties.uppercase: If [code]true[/code], all the text displays as UPPERCASE.
properties.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
properties.autowrap_mode: If set to something other than [constant TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF], the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle. If you resize the node, it will change its height automatically to show all the text.
properties.pixel_size:
The size of one pixel's width on the text to scale it in 3D. This property works in tandem with [member font_size].
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.scale] instead.
properties.curve_step:
Step (in pixels) used to approximate Bézier curves. Lower values result in smoother curves, but is slower to generate and render. Consider adjusting this according to the font size and the typical viewing distance.
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts.
properties.depth: Depths of the mesh, if set to [code]0.0[/code] only front surface, is generated, and UV layout is changed to use full texture for the front face only.
properties.width: Text width (in pixels), used for fill alignment.
properties.offset:
The text drawing offset (in pixels).
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation. To change the text's position in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.position] instead.
properties.language: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.
properties.structured_text_bidi_override: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.
properties.structured_text_bidi_override_options: Set additional options for BiDi override.

TextParagraph.description: Abstraction over [TextServer] for handling a single paragraph of text.

methods.clear: Clears text paragraph (removes text and inline objects).
methods.get_inferred_direction: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
methods.set_bidi_override:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.
methods.set_dropcap: Sets drop cap, overrides previously set drop cap. Drop cap (dropped capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is larger than the rest of the text.
methods.add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it.
methods.add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.
methods.resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
methods.has_object: Returns [code]true[/code] if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.
methods.tab_align: Aligns paragraph to the given tab-stops.
methods.get_non_wrapped_size: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph, without line breaks.
methods.get_size: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph.
methods.get_rid: Returns TextServer full string buffer RID.
methods.get_dropcap_rid: Returns drop cap text buffer RID.
methods.get_range: Returns the character range of the paragraph.
methods.get_line_count: Returns number of lines in the paragraph.
methods.get_line_objects: Returns array of inline objects in the line.
methods.get_line_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
methods.get_line_size: Returns size of the bounding box of the line of text. Returned size is rounded up.
methods.get_line_range: Returns character range of the line.
methods.get_line_ascent: Returns the text line ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
methods.get_line_descent: Returns the text line descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
methods.get_line_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the line of text.
methods.get_line_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods.get_dropcap_size: Returns drop cap bounding box size.
methods.get_dropcap_lines: Returns number of lines used by dropcap.
methods.draw: Draw all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_outline: Draw outlines of all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_line: Draw single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_line_outline: Draw outline of the single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_dropcap: Draw drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.draw_dropcap_outline: Draw drop cap outline into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods.hit_test: Returns caret character offset at the specified coordinates. This function always returns a valid position.

properties.custom_punctuation: Custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
properties.preserve_invalid: If set to [code]true[/code] text will display invalid characters.
properties.preserve_control: If set to [code]true[/code] text will display control characters.
properties.break_flags: Line breaking rules. For more info see [TextServer].
properties.text_overrun_behavior: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the paragraph's set width.
properties.ellipsis_char: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.
properties.max_lines_visible: Limits the lines of text shown.
properties.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.

TextServer.brief: A server interface for font management and text rendering.
TextServer.description:
[TextServer] is the API backend for managing fonts and rendering text.
[b]Note:[/b] This is a low-level API, consider using [TextLine], [TextParagraph], and [Font] classes instead.
This is an abstract class, so to get the currently active [TextServer] instance, use the following code:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
var ts = TextServerManager.GetPrimaryInterface();
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]

methods.has_feature: Returns [code]true[/code] if the server supports a feature.
methods.get_name: Returns the name of the server interface.
methods.get_features: Returns text server features, see [enum Feature].
methods.load_support_data:
Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
[b]Note:[/b] This function should be called before any other TextServer functions used, otherwise it won't have any effect.
methods.get_support_data_filename: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.
methods.get_support_data_info: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.
methods.save_support_data:
Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.
[b]Note:[/b] This function is used by during project export, to include TextServer database.
methods.get_support_data: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
methods.is_locale_using_support_data: Returns [code]true[/code] if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.
methods.name_to_tag: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.
methods.tag_to_name: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.
methods.has: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param rid] is valid resource owned by this text server.
methods.free_rid: Frees an object created by this [TextServer].
methods.create_font: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.
methods.create_font_linked_variation: Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.
methods.font_set_data: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.
methods.font_set_face_index: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods.font_get_face_index: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods.font_get_face_count: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods.font_set_style:
Sets the font style flags.
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], [method font_set_embolden], or [method font_set_transform] instead.
methods.font_get_ot_name_strings: Returns [Dictionary] with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).
methods.font_set_weight:
Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_embolden] instead.
methods.font_get_weight: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].
methods.font_set_stretch:
Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_transform] instead.
methods.font_get_stretch: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].
methods.font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps: If set to [code]true[/code], embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).
methods.font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.
methods.font_set_generate_mipmaps: If set to [code]true[/code] font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
methods.font_get_generate_mipmaps: Returns [code]true[/code] if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
methods.font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_fi:
If set to [code]true[/code], glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.
[b]Note:[/b] MSDF font rendering does not render glyphs with overlapping shapes correctly. Overlapping shapes are not valid per the OpenType standard, but are still commonly found in many font files, especially those converted by Google Fonts. To avoid issues with overlapping glyphs, consider downloading the font file directly from the type foundry instead of relying on Google Fonts.
methods.font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fie: Returns [code]true[/code] if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.
methods.font_set_msdf_pixel_range: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
methods.font_get_msdf_pixel_range: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
methods.font_set_msdf_size: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
methods.font_get_msdf_size: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
methods.font_set_fixed_size: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.
methods.font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if [code]fixed_size[/code] is greater than zero.
methods.font_set_allow_system_fallback: If set to [code]true[/code], system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
methods.font_is_allow_system_fallback: Returns [code]true[/code] if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
methods.font_clear_system_fallback_cache: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.
methods.font_set_force_autohinter: If set to [code]true[/code] auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.
methods.font_is_force_autohinter: Returns [code]true[/code] if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods.font_set_modulate_color_glyphs: If set to [code]true[/code], color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
methods.font_is_modulate_color_glyphs: Returns [code]true[/code] if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.
methods.font_set_hinting: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods.font_get_hinting: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods.font_set_subpixel_positioning: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
methods.font_get_subpixel_positioning: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
methods.font_set_keep_rounding_remainders: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
methods.font_get_keep_rounding_remainders: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
methods.font_set_embolden: Sets font embolden strength. If [param strength] is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.
methods.font_set_spacing: Sets the spacing for [param spacing] to [param value] in pixels (not relative to the font size).
methods.font_get_spacing: Returns the spacing for [param spacing] in pixels (not relative to the font size).
methods.font_set_baseline_offset: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
methods.font_get_baseline_offset: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
methods.font_set_transform:
Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
For example, to simulate italic typeface by slanting, apply the following transform [code]Transform2D(1.0, slant, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0)[/code].
methods.font_get_transform: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.
methods.font_set_variation_coordinates: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.
methods.font_get_variation_coordinates: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.
methods.font_set_oversampling: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling[/code] parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_*[/code] methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods.font_get_oversampling: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling[/code] parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_*[/code] methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods.font_get_size_cache_list: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is [Vector2i] with font size and outline size.
methods.font_clear_size_cache: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.
methods.font_remove_size_cache: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.
methods.font_get_size_cache_info: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: [code]Vector2i size_px[/code] - font size in pixels, [code]float viewport_oversampling[/code] - viewport oversampling factor, [code]int glyphs[/code] - number of rendered glyphs, [code]int textures[/code] - number of used textures, [code]int textures_size[/code] - size of texture data in bytes.
methods.font_set_ascent: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
methods.font_get_ascent: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
methods.font_set_descent: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
methods.font_get_descent: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
methods.font_set_underline_position: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods.font_get_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods.font_set_underline_thickness: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.
methods.font_get_underline_thickness: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.
methods.font_set_scale: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
methods.font_get_scale: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
methods.font_get_texture_count: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.
methods.font_clear_textures:
Removes all textures from font cache entry.
[b]Note:[/b] This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, use [method font_remove_glyph] to remove them manually.
methods.font_remove_texture:
Removes specified texture from the cache entry.
[b]Note:[/b] This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, remove them manually, using [method font_remove_glyph].
methods.font_set_texture_image: Sets font cache texture image data.
methods.font_get_texture_image: Returns font cache texture image data.
methods.font_set_texture_offsets: Sets array containing glyph packing data.
methods.font_get_texture_offsets: Returns array containing glyph packing data.
methods.font_get_glyph_list: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.
methods.font_clear_glyphs:
Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
[b]Note:[/b] This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use [method font_remove_texture] to remove them manually.
methods.font_remove_glyph:
Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
[b]Note:[/b] This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use [method font_remove_texture] to remove them manually.
methods.font_get_glyph_advance:
Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
[b]Note:[/b] Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.
methods.font_set_glyph_advance:
Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
[b]Note:[/b] Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.
methods.font_get_glyph_offset: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.
methods.font_set_glyph_offset: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.
methods.font_get_glyph_uv_rect: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods.font_set_glyph_uv_rect: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods.font_get_glyph_texture_idx: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods.font_set_glyph_texture_idx: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods.font_get_glyph_texture_rid:
Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.
[b]Note:[/b] If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.
methods.font_get_glyph_texture_size:
Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.
[b]Note:[/b] If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.
methods.font_get_glyph_contours:
Returns outline contours of the glyph as a [Dictionary] with the following contents:
[code]points[/code]         - [PackedVector3Array], containing outline points. [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] are point coordinates. [code]z[/code] is the type of the point, using the [enum ContourPointTag] values.
[code]contours[/code]       - [PackedInt32Array], containing indices the end points of each contour.
[code]orientation[/code]    - [bool], contour orientation. If [code]true[/code], clockwise contours must be filled.
- Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a line segment.
- One [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicates a single conic (quadratic) Bézier arc.
- Two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CUBIC] points between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a single cubic Bézier arc.
- Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] points indicate two successive conic (quadratic) Bézier arcs with a virtual [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] point at their middle.
- Each contour is closed. The last point of a contour uses the first point of a contour as its next point, and vice versa. The first point can be [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point.
methods.font_get_kerning_list: Returns list of the kerning overrides.
methods.font_remove_kerning: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.
methods.font_set_kerning: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.
methods.font_get_kerning: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.
methods.font_get_glyph_index: Returns the glyph index of a [param char], optionally modified by the [param variation_selector]. See [method font_get_char_from_glyph_index].
methods.font_get_char_from_glyph_index: Returns character code associated with [param glyph_index], or [code]0[/code] if [param glyph_index] is invalid. See [method font_get_glyph_index].
methods.font_has_char: Returns [code]true[/code] if a Unicode [param char] is available in the font.
methods.font_get_supported_chars: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.
methods.font_get_supported_glyphs: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.
methods.font_render_range: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.
methods.font_render_glyph: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.
methods.font_draw_glyph:
Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[b]Note:[/b] Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by [method shaped_text_get_glyphs] or [method font_get_glyph_index].
[b]Note:[/b] If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.
methods.font_draw_glyph_outline:
Draws single glyph outline of size [param outline_size] into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[b]Note:[/b] Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by [method shaped_text_get_glyphs] or [method font_get_glyph_index].
[b]Note:[/b] If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.
methods.font_is_language_supported: Returns [code]true[/code] if the font supports the given language (as a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_639-1]ISO 639[/url] code).
methods.font_get_language_support_override: Returns [code]true[/code] if support override is enabled for the [param language].
methods.font_get_language_support_overrides: Returns list of language support overrides.
methods.font_is_script_supported: Returns [code]true[/code] if the font supports the given script (as a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_15924]ISO 15924[/url] code).
methods.font_get_script_support_override: Returns [code]true[/code] if support override is enabled for the [param script].
methods.font_get_script_support_overrides: Returns list of script support overrides.
methods.font_set_opentype_feature_overrides: Sets font OpenType feature set override.
methods.font_get_opentype_feature_overrides: Returns font OpenType feature set override.
methods.font_supported_feature_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.
methods.font_supported_variation_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.
methods.font_get_global_oversampling: This method does nothing and always returns [code]1.0[/code].
methods.get_hex_code_box_size: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).
methods.draw_hex_code_box: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code. Used for replacing missing characters.
methods.create_shaped_text:
Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given [param direction] and [param orientation]. To free the resulting buffer, use [method free_rid] method.
[b]Note:[/b] Direction is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
[b]Note:[/b] Orientation is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
methods.shaped_text_clear: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).
methods.shaped_text_set_direction:
Sets desired text direction. If set to [constant DIRECTION_AUTO], direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.
[b]Note:[/b] Direction is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
methods.shaped_text_get_inferred_direction: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
methods.shaped_text_set_bidi_override:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.
methods.shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
methods.shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
methods.shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.
methods.shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.
methods.shaped_text_set_orientation:
Sets desired text orientation.
[b]Note:[/b] Orientation is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
methods.shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid: If set to [code]true[/code] text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.
methods.shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid:
Returns [code]true[/code] if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.
[b]Note:[/b] If set to [code]false[/code], nothing is displayed in place of invalid characters.
methods.shaped_text_set_preserve_control: If set to [code]true[/code] text buffer will display control characters.
methods.shaped_text_get_preserve_control: Returns [code]true[/code] if text buffer is configured to display control characters.
methods.shaped_text_set_spacing: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
methods.shaped_text_get_spacing: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
methods.shaped_text_add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.
methods.shaped_text_add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.
methods.shaped_text_resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
methods.shaped_text_has_object: Returns [code]true[/code] if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.
methods.shaped_get_text: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.
methods.shaped_get_span_count: Returns number of text spans added using [method shaped_text_add_string] or [method shaped_text_add_object].
methods.shaped_get_span_text: Returns the text span source text.
methods.shaped_get_span_object: Returns the text span embedded object key.
methods.shaped_set_span_update_font: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.
methods.shaped_get_run_count: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.
methods.shaped_get_run_text: Returns the source text of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_range: Returns the source text range of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_font_rid: Returns the font RID of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_font_size: Returns the font size of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_language: Returns the language of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_direction: Returns the direction of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_get_run_object: Returns the embedded object of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods.shaped_text_substr: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the [param shaped] text buffer (including inline objects).
methods.shaped_text_get_parent: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.
methods.shaped_text_fit_to_width: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.
methods.shaped_text_tab_align: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.
methods.shaped_text_shape:
Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns [code]true[/code] if the string is shaped successfully.
[b]Note:[/b] It is not necessary to call this function manually, buffer will be shaped automatically as soon as any of its output data is requested.
methods.shaped_text_is_ready: Returns [code]true[/code] if buffer is successfully shaped.
methods.shaped_text_has_visible_chars: Returns [code]true[/code] if text buffer contains any visible characters.
methods.shaped_text_get_glyphs: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.
methods.shaped_text_sort_logical: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.
methods.shaped_text_get_glyph_count: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.
methods.shaped_text_get_range: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.
methods.shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.
methods.shaped_text_get_line_breaks: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.
methods.shaped_text_get_word_breaks: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use [param grapheme_flags] to set what characters are used for breaking.
methods.shaped_text_get_trim_pos: Returns the position of the overrun trim.
methods.shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.
methods.shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.
methods.shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.
methods.shaped_text_get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
methods.shaped_text_get_object_range: Returns the character range of the inline object.
methods.shaped_text_get_object_glyph: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.
methods.shaped_text_get_ascent:
Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
[b]Note:[/b] Overall ascent can be higher than font ascent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.
methods.shaped_text_get_descent:
Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
[b]Note:[/b] Overall descent can be higher than font descent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.
methods.shaped_text_get_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.
methods.shaped_text_get_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods.shaped_text_get_carets: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset [param position] in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.
methods.shaped_text_get_selection: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.
methods.shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or [code]-1[/code] if none is found.
methods.shaped_text_hit_test_position: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
methods.shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.
methods.shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme end position closest to the [param pos].
methods.shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme start position closest to the [param pos].
methods.shaped_text_get_character_breaks: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
methods.shaped_text_next_character_pos: Returns composite character end position closest to the [param pos].
methods.shaped_text_prev_character_pos: Returns composite character start position closest to the [param pos].
methods.shaped_text_closest_character_pos: Returns composite character position closest to the [param pos].
methods.shaped_text_draw:
Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.
methods.shaped_text_draw_outline:
Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.
methods.shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_ra: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.
methods.format_number:
Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used in the given [param language].
If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.
methods.parse_number:
Converts [param number] from the numeral system used in the given [param language] to Western Arabic (0..9).
If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.
methods.percent_sign:
Returns the percent sign used in the given [param language].
