If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.
methods.string_get_word_breaks:
Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even.
When [param chars_per_line] is greater than zero, line break boundaries are returned instead.
[codeblock]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engine", and "4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4")) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 16, 18, 19]
# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engin", and "e, 4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 5)) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 15, 15, 19]
# Corresponds to the substrings "The Godot" and "Engine, 4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 10)) # Prints [0, 9, 10, 19]
[/codeblock]
methods.string_get_character_breaks:
Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
[codeblock]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
print(ts.string_get_character_breaks("Test ❤️‍🔥 Test")) # Prints [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]
[/codeblock]
methods.is_confusable:
Returns index of the first string in [param dict] which is visually confusable with the [param string], or [code]-1[/code] if none is found.
[b]Note:[/b] This method doesn't detect invisible characters, for spoof detection use it in combination with [method spoof_check].
[b]Note:[/b] Always returns [code]-1[/code] if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.
methods.spoof_check:
Returns [code]true[/code] if [param string] is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader.
[b]Note:[/b] Always returns [code]false[/code] if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.
methods.strip_diacritics:
Strips diacritics from the string.
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.
methods.is_valid_identifier:
Returns [code]true[/code] if [param string] is a valid identifier.
If the text server supports the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature, a valid identifier must:
- Conform to normalization form C.
- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or [code]"_"[/code].
- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.
- Use UAX #31 recommended scripts only (mixed scripts are allowed).
If the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature is not supported, a valid identifier must:
- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or [code]"_"[/code].
- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.
methods.is_valid_letter: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs to the Unicode category "L".
methods.string_to_upper:
Returns the string converted to [code]UPPERCASE[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.
methods.string_to_lower:
Returns the string converted to [code]lowercase[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.
methods.string_to_title:
Returns the string converted to [code]Title Case[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.
methods.parse_structured_text: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.

TextServerAdvanced.brief: An advanced text server with support for BiDi, complex text layout, and contextual OpenType features. Used in Godot by default.
TextServerAdvanced.description: An implementation of [TextServer] that uses HarfBuzz, ICU and SIL Graphite to support BiDi, complex text layouts and contextual OpenType features. This is Godot's default primary [TextServer] interface.

TextServerDummy.brief: A dummy text server that can't render text or manage fonts.

TextServerExtension.description: External [TextServer] implementations should inherit from this class.

methods._has_feature: Returns [code]true[/code] if the server supports a feature.
methods._get_name: Returns the name of the server interface.
methods._get_features: Returns text server features, see [enum TextServer.Feature].
methods._free_rid: Frees an object created by this [TextServer].
methods._has: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param rid] is valid resource owned by this text server.
methods._load_support_data: Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
methods._get_support_data_filename: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.
methods._get_support_data_info: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.
methods._save_support_data: Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.
methods._get_support_data: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
methods._is_locale_using_support_data: Returns [code]true[/code] if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.
methods._name_to_tag: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.
methods._tag_to_name: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.
methods._create_font: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource.
methods._create_font_linked_variation:
Optional, implement if font supports extra spacing or baseline offset.
Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data.
methods._font_set_data: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.
methods._font_set_data_ptr: Sets pointer to the font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.
methods._font_set_face_index: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods._font_get_face_index: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods._font_get_face_count: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.
methods._font_get_ot_name_strings: Returns [Dictionary] with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).
methods._font_set_weight: Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].
methods._font_get_weight: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].
methods._font_set_stretch: Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].
methods._font_get_stretch: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].
methods._font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps: If set to [code]true[/code], embedded font bitmap loading is disabled.
methods._font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.
methods._font_set_generate_mipmaps: If set to [code]true[/code] font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
methods._font_get_generate_mipmaps: Returns [code]true[/code] if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.
methods._font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_f: If set to [code]true[/code], glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.
methods._font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fi: Returns [code]true[/code] if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.
methods._font_set_msdf_pixel_range: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
methods._font_get_msdf_pixel_range: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.
methods._font_set_msdf_size: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
methods._font_get_msdf_size: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.
methods._font_set_fixed_size: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.
methods._font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if [code]fixed_size[/code] is greater than zero.
methods._font_set_allow_system_fallback: If set to [code]true[/code], system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
methods._font_is_allow_system_fallback: Returns [code]true[/code] if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.
methods._font_clear_system_fallback_cache: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.
methods._font_set_force_autohinter: If set to [code]true[/code] auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.
methods._font_is_force_autohinter: Returns [code]true[/code] if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.
methods._font_set_modulate_color_glyphs: If set to [code]true[/code], color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.
methods._font_is_modulate_color_glyphs: Returns [code]true[/code] if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.
methods._font_set_hinting: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods._font_get_hinting: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods._font_set_subpixel_positioning: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
methods._font_get_subpixel_positioning: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.
methods._font_set_keep_rounding_remainders: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
methods._font_get_keep_rounding_remainders: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.
methods._font_set_embolden: Sets font embolden strength. If [param strength] is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.
methods._font_set_spacing: Sets the spacing for [param spacing] to [param value] in pixels (not relative to the font size).
methods._font_get_spacing: Returns the spacing for [param spacing] in pixels (not relative to the font size).
methods._font_set_baseline_offset: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
methods._font_get_baseline_offset: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).
methods._font_set_transform: Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
methods._font_get_transform: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.
methods._font_set_variation_coordinates: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.
methods._font_get_variation_coordinates: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.
methods._font_set_oversampling: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling[/code] parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_*[/code] methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods._font_get_oversampling: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling[/code] parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_*[/code] methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.
methods._font_get_size_cache_list: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is [Vector2i] with font size and outline size.
methods._font_clear_size_cache: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.
methods._font_remove_size_cache: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.

methods._font_set_ascent: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
methods._font_get_ascent: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).
methods._font_set_descent: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
methods._font_get_descent: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).
methods._font_set_underline_position: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods._font_get_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods._font_set_underline_thickness: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.
methods._font_get_underline_thickness: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.
methods._font_set_scale: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
methods._font_get_scale: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.
methods._font_get_texture_count: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.
methods._font_clear_textures: Removes all textures from font cache entry.
methods._font_remove_texture: Removes specified texture from the cache entry.
methods._font_set_texture_image: Sets font cache texture image data.
methods._font_get_texture_image: Returns font cache texture image data.
methods._font_set_texture_offsets: Sets array containing glyph packing data.
methods._font_get_texture_offsets: Returns array containing glyph packing data.
methods._font_get_glyph_list: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.

methods._font_set_glyph_texture_idx: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods._font_get_glyph_texture_rid: Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods._font_get_glyph_texture_size: Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.
methods._font_get_glyph_contours: Returns outline contours of the glyph.

methods._font_get_kerning: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.

methods._font_get_script_support_overrides: Returns list of script support overrides.
methods._font_set_opentype_feature_overrides: Sets font OpenType feature set override.
methods._font_get_opentype_feature_overrides: Returns font OpenType feature set override.
methods._font_supported_feature_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.
methods._font_supported_variation_list: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.
methods._font_get_global_oversampling: Returns the font oversampling factor, shared by all fonts in the TextServer.
methods._font_set_global_oversampling: Sets oversampling factor, shared by all font in the TextServer.
methods._reference_oversampling_level: Increases the reference count of the specified oversampling level. This method is called by [Viewport], and should not be used directly.
methods._unreference_oversampling_level: Decreases the reference count of the specified oversampling level, and frees the font cache for oversampling level when the reference count reaches zero. This method is called by [Viewport], and should not be used directly.
methods._get_hex_code_box_size: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).
methods._draw_hex_code_box: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code.
methods._create_shaped_text: Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given [param direction] and [param orientation].
methods._shaped_text_clear: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).
methods._shaped_text_set_direction: Sets desired text direction. If set to [constant TextServer.DIRECTION_AUTO], direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.
methods._shaped_text_get_inferred_direction: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.
methods._shaped_text_set_bidi_override: Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
methods._shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
methods._shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.
methods._shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.
methods._shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.
methods._shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid: If set to [code]true[/code] text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.
methods._shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid: Returns [code]true[/code] if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.
methods._shaped_text_set_preserve_control: If set to [code]true[/code] text buffer will display control characters.
methods._shaped_text_get_preserve_control: Returns [code]true[/code] if text buffer is configured to display control characters.
methods._shaped_text_set_spacing: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
methods._shaped_text_get_spacing: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.
methods._shaped_text_add_string: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.
methods._shaped_text_add_object: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.
methods._shaped_text_resize_object: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.
methods._shaped_text_has_object: Returns [code]true[/code] if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.
methods._shaped_get_text: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.
methods._shaped_get_span_count: Returns number of text spans added using [method _shaped_text_add_string] or [method _shaped_text_add_object].
methods._shaped_get_span_text: Returns the text span source text.
methods._shaped_get_span_object: Returns the text span embedded object key.
methods._shaped_set_span_update_font: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.
methods._shaped_get_run_count: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.
methods._shaped_get_run_text: Returns the source text of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_range: Returns the source text range of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_font_rid: Returns the font RID of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_font_size: Returns the font size of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_language: Returns the language of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_direction: Returns the direction of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_get_run_object: Returns the embedded object of the [param index] text run (in visual order).
methods._shaped_text_substr: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the [param shaped] text buffer (including inline objects).
methods._shaped_text_get_parent: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.
methods._shaped_text_fit_to_width: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.
methods._shaped_text_tab_align: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.
methods._shaped_text_shape: Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns [code]true[/code] if the string is shaped successfully.
methods._shaped_text_update_breaks: Updates break points in the shaped text. This method is called by default implementation of text breaking functions.
methods._shaped_text_update_justification_ops: Updates justification points in the shaped text. This method is called by default implementation of text justification functions.
methods._shaped_text_is_ready: Returns [code]true[/code] if buffer is successfully shaped.
methods._shaped_text_get_glyphs: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.
methods._shaped_text_sort_logical: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.
methods._shaped_text_get_glyph_count: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.
methods._shaped_text_get_range: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.
methods._shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.
methods._shaped_text_get_line_breaks: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.
methods._shaped_text_get_word_breaks: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use [param grapheme_flags] to set what characters are used for breaking.
methods._shaped_text_get_trim_pos: Returns the position of the overrun trim.
methods._shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.
methods._shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.
methods._shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.
methods._shaped_text_get_object_rect: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.
methods._shaped_text_get_object_range: Returns the character range of the inline object.
methods._shaped_text_get_object_glyph: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.
methods._shaped_text_get_ascent: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
methods._shaped_text_get_descent: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
methods._shaped_text_get_width: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.
methods._shaped_text_get_underline_position: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
methods._shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_r: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.
methods._shaped_text_get_carets: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset [param position] in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.
methods._shaped_text_get_selection: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.
methods._shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or [code]-1[/code] if none is found.
methods._shaped_text_hit_test_position: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.
methods._shaped_text_draw: Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods._shaped_text_draw_outline: Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
methods._shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.
methods._shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme end position closest to the [param pos].
methods._shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos: Returns grapheme start position closest to the [param pos].
methods._shaped_text_get_character_breaks: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
methods._shaped_text_next_character_pos: Returns composite character end position closest to the [param pos].
methods._shaped_text_prev_character_pos: Returns composite character start position closest to the [param pos].
methods._shaped_text_closest_character_pos: Returns composite character position closest to the [param pos].
methods._format_number:
Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used in the given [param language].
If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.
methods._parse_number:
Converts [param number] from the numeral system used in the given [param language] to Western Arabic (0..9).
If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.
methods._percent_sign: Returns percent sign used in the given [param language].
methods._is_valid_identifier: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param string] is a valid identifier.
methods._string_get_word_breaks: Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even.
methods._string_get_character_breaks: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
methods._is_confusable: Returns index of the first string in [param dict] which is visually confusable with the [param string], or [code]-1[/code] if none is found.
methods._spoof_check: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param string] is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader.
methods._string_to_title: Returns the string converted to [code]Title Case[/code].
methods._parse_structured_text: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.
methods._cleanup: This method is called before text server is unregistered.

TextServerManager.description:
[TextServerManager] is the API backend for loading, enumerating, and switching [TextServer]s.
[b]Note:[/b] Switching text server at runtime is possible, but will invalidate all fonts and text buffers. Make sure to unload all controls, fonts, and themes before doing so.

methods.get_interface_count: Returns the number of interfaces currently registered.
methods.remove_interface: Removes an interface. All fonts and shaped text caches should be freed before removing an interface.
methods.get_interface: Returns the interface registered at a given index.
methods.get_interfaces: Returns a list of available interfaces, with the index and name of each interface.
methods.find_interface: Finds an interface by its [param name].
methods.get_primary_interface: Returns the primary [TextServer] interface currently in use.

signals.interface_added: Emitted when a new interface has been added.
signals.interface_removed: Emitted when an interface is removed.

Texture.brief: Base class for all texture types.
Texture.description: [Texture] is the base class for all texture types. Common texture types are [Texture2D] and [ImageTexture]. See also [Image].

Texture2D.description:
A texture works by registering an image in the video hardware, which then can be used in 3D models or 2D [Sprite2D] or GUI [Control].
Textures are often created by loading them from a file. See [method @GDScript.load].
[Texture2D] is a base for other resources. It cannot be used directly.
[b]Note:[/b] The maximum texture size is 16384×16384 pixels due to graphics hardware limitations. Larger textures may fail to import.

methods._get_width: Called when the [Texture2D]'s width is queried.
methods._get_height: Called when the [Texture2D]'s height is queried.
methods._is_pixel_opaque: Called when a pixel's opaque state in the [Texture2D] is queried at the specified [code](x, y)[/code] position.
methods._has_alpha: Called when the presence of an alpha channel in the [Texture2D] is queried.
methods._draw:
Called when the entire [Texture2D] is requested to be drawn over a [CanvasItem], with the top-left offset specified in [param pos]. [param modulate] specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while [param transpose] specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
[b]Note:[/b] This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.
methods._draw_rect:
Called when the [Texture2D] is requested to be drawn onto [CanvasItem]'s specified [param rect]. [param modulate] specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while [param transpose] specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
[b]Note:[/b] This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.
methods._draw_rect_region:
Called when a part of the [Texture2D] specified by [param src_rect]'s coordinates is requested to be drawn onto [CanvasItem]'s specified [param rect]. [param modulate] specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while [param transpose] specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
[b]Note:[/b] This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.
methods.get_width: Returns the texture width in pixels.
methods.get_height: Returns the texture height in pixels.
methods.get_size: Returns the texture size in pixels.
methods.has_alpha: Returns [code]true[/code] if this [Texture2D] has an alpha channel.
methods.draw: Draws the texture using a [CanvasItem] with the [RenderingServer] API at the specified [param position].
methods.draw_rect: Draws the texture using a [CanvasItem] with the [RenderingServer] API.
methods.draw_rect_region: Draws a part of the texture using a [CanvasItem] with the [RenderingServer] API.
methods.get_image:
Returns an [Image] that is a copy of data from this [Texture2D] (a new [Image] is created each time). [Image]s can be accessed and manipulated directly.
[b]Note:[/b] This will return [code]null[/code] if this [Texture2D] is invalid.
[b]Note:[/b] This will fetch the texture data from the GPU, which might cause performance problems when overused. Avoid calling [method get_image] every frame, especially on large textures.
methods.create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource ([PlaceholderTexture2D]).

Texture2DArray.brief: A single texture resource which consists of multiple, separate images. Each image has the same dimensions and number of mipmap levels.
Texture2DArray.description:
A Texture2DArray is different from a Texture3D: The Texture2DArray does not support trilinear interpolation between the [Image]s, i.e. no blending. See also [Cubemap] and [CubemapArray], which are texture arrays with specialized cubemap functions.
A Texture2DArray is also different from an [AtlasTexture]: In a Texture2DArray, all images are treated separately. In an atlas, the regions (i.e. the single images) can be of different sizes. Furthermore, you usually need to add a padding around the regions, to prevent accidental UV mapping to more than one region. The same goes for mipmapping: Mipmap chains are handled separately for each layer. In an atlas, the slicing has to be done manually in the fragment shader.
To create such a texture file yourself, reimport your image files using the Godot Editor import presets. To create a Texture2DArray from code, use [method ImageTextureLayered.create_from_images] on an instance of the Texture2DArray class.

methods.create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource ([PlaceholderTexture2DArray]).

Texture2DArrayRD.brief: Texture Array for 2D that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
Texture2DArrayRD.description:
This texture array class allows you to use a 2D array texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [Texture2DArrayRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Texture2DArray] instead.

Texture2DRD.brief: Texture for 2D that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
Texture2DRD.description:
This texture class allows you to use a 2D texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [Texture2DRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Texture2D] instead.

properties.texture_rd_rid: The RID of the texture object created on the [RenderingDevice].

Texture3D.description:
Base class for [ImageTexture3D] and [CompressedTexture3D]. Cannot be used directly, but contains all the functions necessary for accessing the derived resource types. [Texture3D] is the base class for all 3-dimensional texture types. See also [TextureLayered].
All images need to have the same width, height and number of mipmap levels.
To create such a texture file yourself, reimport your image files using the Godot Editor import presets.

methods._get_format: Called when the [Texture3D]'s format is queried.
methods._get_width: Called when the [Texture3D]'s width is queried.
methods._get_height: Called when the [Texture3D]'s height is queried.
methods._get_depth: Called when the [Texture3D]'s depth is queried.
methods._has_mipmaps: Called when the presence of mipmaps in the [Texture3D] is queried.
methods._get_data: Called when the [Texture3D]'s data is queried.
methods.get_format: Returns the current format being used by this texture.
methods.get_width: Returns the [Texture3D]'s width in pixels. Width is typically represented by the X axis.
methods.get_height: Returns the [Texture3D]'s height in pixels. Width is typically represented by the Y axis.
methods.get_depth: Returns the [Texture3D]'s depth in pixels. Depth is typically represented by the Z axis (a dimension not present in [Texture2D]).
methods.has_mipmaps: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [Texture3D] has generated mipmaps.
methods.get_data: Returns the [Texture3D]'s data as an array of [Image]s. Each [Image] represents a [i]slice[/i] of the [Texture3D], with different slices mapping to different depth (Z axis) levels.
methods.create_placeholder: Creates a placeholder version of this resource ([PlaceholderTexture3D]).

Texture3DRD.brief: Texture for 3D that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
Texture3DRD.description:
This texture class allows you to use a 3D texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [Texture3DRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Texture3D] instead.

properties.texture_rd_rid: The RID of the texture object created on the [RenderingDevice].

TextureButton.brief: Texture-based button. Supports Pressed, Hover, Disabled and Focused states.
TextureButton.description:
[TextureButton] has the same functionality as [Button], except it uses sprites instead of Godot's [Theme] resource. It is faster to create, but it doesn't support localization like more complex [Control]s.
See also [BaseButton] which contains common properties and methods associated with this node.
[b]Note:[/b] Setting a texture for the "normal" state ([member texture_normal]) is recommended. If [member texture_normal] is not set, the [TextureButton] will still receive input events and be clickable, but the user will not be able to see it unless they activate another one of its states with a texture assigned (e.g., hover over it to show [member texture_hover]).

properties.texture_normal: Texture to display by default, when the node is [b]not[/b] in the disabled, hover or pressed state. This texture is still displayed in the focused state, with [member texture_focused] drawn on top.
properties.texture_pressed: Texture to display on mouse down over the node, if the node has keyboard focus and the player presses the Enter key or if the player presses the [member BaseButton.shortcut] key. If not assigned, the [TextureButton] displays [member texture_hover] instead when pressed.
properties.texture_hover: Texture to display when the mouse hovers over the node. If not assigned, the [TextureButton] displays [member texture_normal] instead when hovered over.
properties.texture_disabled: Texture to display when the node is disabled. See [member BaseButton.disabled]. If not assigned, the [TextureButton] displays [member texture_normal] instead.
properties.texture_focused: Texture to [i]overlay on the base texture[/i] when the node has mouse or keyboard focus. Because [member texture_focused] is displayed on top of the base texture, a partially transparent texture should be used to ensure the base texture remains visible. A texture that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a fully transparent texture of any size. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.
properties.texture_click_mask: Pure black and white [BitMap] image to use for click detection. On the mask, white pixels represent the button's clickable area. Use it to create buttons with curved shapes.
properties.ignore_texture_size: If [code]true[/code], the size of the texture won't be considered for minimum size calculation, so the [TextureButton] can be shrunk down past the texture size.
properties.stretch_mode: Controls the texture's behavior when you resize the node's bounding rectangle. See the [enum StretchMode] constants for available options.

TextureCubemapArrayRD.brief: Texture Array for Cubemaps that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
TextureCubemapArrayRD.description:
This texture class allows you to use a cubemap array texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [TextureCubemapArrayRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [CubemapArray] instead.

TextureCubemapRD.brief: Texture for Cubemap that is bound to a texture created on the [RenderingDevice].
TextureCubemapRD.description:
This texture class allows you to use a cubemap texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [TextureCubemapRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Cubemap] instead.

TextureLayered.brief: Base class for texture types which contain the data of multiple [Image]s. Each image is of the same size and format.
TextureLayered.description:
Base class for [ImageTextureLayered] and [CompressedTextureLayered]. Cannot be used directly, but contains all the functions necessary for accessing the derived resource types. See also [Texture3D].
Data is set on a per-layer basis. For [Texture2DArray]s, the layer specifies the array layer.
All images need to have the same width, height and number of mipmap levels.
A [TextureLayered] can be loaded with [method ResourceLoader.load].
Internally, Godot maps these files to their respective counterparts in the target rendering driver (Vulkan, OpenGL3).

methods._get_format: Called when the [TextureLayered]'s format is queried.
methods._get_layered_type: Called when the layers' type in the [TextureLayered] is queried.
methods._get_height: Called when the [TextureLayered]'s height is queried.
methods._get_layers: Called when the number of layers in the [TextureLayered] is queried.
methods._has_mipmaps: Called when the presence of mipmaps in the [TextureLayered] is queried.
methods._get_layer_data: Called when the data for a layer in the [TextureLayered] is queried.
methods.get_format: Returns the current format being used by this texture.
methods.get_layered_type: Returns the [TextureLayered]'s type. The type determines how the data is accessed, with cubemaps having special types.
methods.get_width: Returns the width of the texture in pixels. Width is typically represented by the X axis.
methods.get_height: Returns the height of the texture in pixels. Height is typically represented by the Y axis.
methods.has_mipmaps: Returns [code]true[/code] if the layers have generated mipmaps.
methods.get_layer_data: Returns an [Image] resource with the data from specified [param layer].

TextureLayeredRD.brief: Abstract base class for layered texture RD types.
TextureLayeredRD.description:
Base class for [Texture2DArrayRD], [TextureCubemapRD] and [TextureCubemapArrayRD]. Cannot be used directly, but contains all the functions necessary for accessing the derived resource types.
[b]Note:[/b] [TextureLayeredRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [TextureLayered] instead.

properties.texture_rd_rid: The RID of the texture object created on the [RenderingDevice].

TextureProgressBar.brief: Texture-based progress bar. Useful for loading screens and life or stamina bars.
TextureProgressBar.description: TextureProgressBar works like [ProgressBar], but uses up to 3 textures instead of Godot's [Theme] resource. It can be used to create horizontal, vertical and radial progress bars.

methods.set_stretch_margin: Sets the stretch margin with the specified index. See [member stretch_margin_bottom] and related properties.
methods.get_stretch_margin: Returns the stretch margin with the specified index. See [member stretch_margin_bottom] and related properties.

properties.fill_mode: The fill direction. See [enum FillMode] for possible values.
properties.radial_initial_angle:
Starting angle for the fill of [member texture_progress] if [member fill_mode] is [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE], [constant FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE], or [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE]. When the node's [code]value[/code] is equal to its [code]min_value[/code], the texture doesn't show up at all. When the [code]value[/code] increases, the texture fills and tends towards [member radial_fill_degrees].
[b]Note:[/b] [member radial_initial_angle] is wrapped between [code]0[/code] and [code]360[/code] degrees (inclusive).
properties.radial_fill_degrees:
Upper limit for the fill of [member texture_progress] if [member fill_mode] is [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE], [constant FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE], or [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE]. When the node's [code]value[/code] is equal to its [code]max_value[/code], the texture fills up to this angle.
See [member Range.value], [member Range.max_value].
properties.radial_center_offset:
Offsets [member texture_progress] if [member fill_mode] is [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE], [constant FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE], or [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE].
[b]Note:[/b] The effective radial center always stays within the [member texture_progress] bounds. If you need to move it outside the texture's bounds, modify the [member texture_progress] to contain additional empty space where needed.
properties.nine_patch_stretch: If [code]true[/code], Godot treats the bar's textures like in [NinePatchRect]. Use the [code]stretch_margin_*[/code] properties like [member stretch_margin_bottom] to set up the nine patch's 3×3 grid. When using a radial [member fill_mode], this setting will only enable stretching for [member texture_progress], while [member texture_under] and [member texture_over] will be treated like in [NinePatchRect].
properties.stretch_margin_left: The width of the 9-patch's left column. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].
properties.stretch_margin_top: The height of the 9-patch's top row. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].
properties.stretch_margin_right: The width of the 9-patch's right column. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].
properties.stretch_margin_bottom: The height of the 9-patch's bottom row. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's bottom corners and side will have a height of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].
properties.texture_under: [Texture2D] that draws under the progress bar. The bar's background.
properties.texture_over: [Texture2D] that draws over the progress bar. Use it to add highlights or an upper-frame that hides part of [member texture_progress].
properties.texture_progress:
[Texture2D] that clips based on the node's [code]value[/code] and [member fill_mode]. As [code]value[/code] increased, the texture fills up. It shows entirely when [code]value[/code] reaches [code]max_value[/code]. It doesn't show at all if [code]value[/code] is equal to [code]min_value[/code].
The [code]value[/code] property comes from [Range]. See [member Range.value], [member Range.min_value], [member Range.max_value].
properties.texture_progress_offset: The offset of [member texture_progress]. Useful for [member texture_over] and [member texture_under] with fancy borders, to avoid transparent margins in your progress texture.
properties.tint_under: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_under] texture.
properties.tint_over: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_over] texture. The effect is similar to [member CanvasItem.modulate], except it only affects this specific texture instead of the entire node.
properties.tint_progress: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_progress] texture.

TextureRect.brief: A control that displays a texture.
TextureRect.description: A control that displays a texture, for example an icon inside a GUI. The texture's placement can be controlled with the [member stretch_mode] property. It can scale, tile, or stay centered inside its bounding rectangle.

properties.expand_mode: Defines how minimum size is determined based on the texture's size.
properties.stretch_mode: Controls the texture's behavior when resizing the node's bounding rectangle.

Theme.brief: A resource used for styling/skinning [Control]s and [Window]s.
Theme.description:
A resource used for styling/skinning [Control] and [Window] nodes. While individual controls can be styled using their local theme overrides (see [method Control.add_theme_color_override]), theme resources allow you to store and apply the same settings across all controls sharing the same type (e.g. style all [Button]s the same). One theme resource can be used for the entire project, but you can also set a separate theme resource to a branch of control nodes. A theme resource assigned to a control applies to the control itself, as well as all of its direct and indirect children (as long as a chain of controls is uninterrupted).
Use [member ProjectSettings.gui/theme/custom] to set up a project-scope theme that will be available to every control in your project.
Use [member Control.theme] of any control node to set up a theme that will be available to that control and all of its direct and indirect children.

methods.set_icon: Creates or changes the value of the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_icon] to remove the property.
methods.get_icon:
Returns the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Returns the engine fallback icon value if the property doesn't exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_icon]). Use [method has_icon] to check for existence.
methods.has_icon:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists.
Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_icon] to define it.
methods.rename_icon:
Renames the icon property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_icon] to check for existence, and [method clear_icon] to remove the existing property.
methods.clear_icon:
Removes the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_icon] to check for existence.
methods.get_icon_list: Returns a list of names for icon properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_icon_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.
methods.get_icon_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for icon properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.
methods.set_stylebox: Creates or changes the value of the [StyleBox] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_stylebox] to remove the property.
methods.get_stylebox:

Returns the engine fallback stylebox value if the property doesn't exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_stylebox]). Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence.
methods.has_stylebox:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the [StyleBox] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists.
Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_stylebox] to define it.
methods.rename_stylebox:
Renames the [StyleBox] property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence, and [method clear_stylebox] to remove the existing property.
methods.clear_stylebox:
Removes the [StyleBox] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence.
methods.get_stylebox_list: Returns a list of names for [StyleBox] properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_stylebox_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.
methods.get_stylebox_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for [StyleBox] properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.
methods.set_font: Creates or changes the value of the [Font] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_font] to remove the property.
methods.get_font:
Returns the [Font] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Returns the default theme font if the property doesn't exist and the default theme font is set up (see [member default_font]). Use [method has_font] to check for existence of the property and [method has_default_font] to check for existence of the default theme font.
Returns the engine fallback font value, if neither exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_font]).
methods.has_font:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the [Font] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists, or if the default theme font is set up (see [method has_default_font]).
Returns [code]false[/code] if neither exist. Use [method set_font] to define the property.
methods.rename_font:
Renames the [Font] property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_font] to check for existence, and [method clear_font] to remove the existing property.
methods.clear_font:
Removes the [Font] property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_font] to check for existence.
methods.get_font_list: Returns a list of names for [Font] properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_font_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.
methods.get_font_type_list: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for [Font] properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

methods.has_font_size:

Returns [code]false[/code] if neither exist. Use [method set_font_size] to define the property.

methods.clear_font_size:

methods.has_default_base_scale:

Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't. The value must be greater than [code]0.0[/code] to be considered valid.
methods.has_default_font:

Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't.
methods.has_default_font_size:

Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't. The value must be greater than [code]0[/code] to be considered valid.
methods.set_theme_item:
Creates or changes the value of the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_theme_item] to remove the property.
Fails if the [param value] type is not accepted by [param data_type].
[b]Note:[/b] This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.
methods.get_theme_item:
Returns the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists.
Returns the engine fallback value if the property doesn't exist (see [ThemeDB]). Use [method has_theme_item] to check for existence.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.
methods.has_theme_item:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists.
Returns [code]false[/code] if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_theme_item] to define it.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.
methods.rename_theme_item:

Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_theme_item] to check for existence, and [method clear_theme_item] to remove the existing property.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.
methods.clear_theme_item:
